summary.vi: Cấu trúc so/such dùng để nhấn mạnh mức độ và thường dẫn đến kết quả, còn too/enough diễn tả việc vượt ngưỡng hoặc đạt ngưỡng cần thiết.
summary.en: So/such emphasise a degree and often lead to a result, while too/enough express being above or reaching a necessary limit.

when_to_use.vi: Khi muốn nhấn mạnh một tính từ hoặc trạng từ và thường nêu kết quả đi kèm, dùng so + adjective/adverb.
when_to_use.en: Use so + adjective/adverb to emphasise a quality and often add the result that follows.

when_to_use.vi: Khi nhấn mạnh một cụm danh từ, dùng such + (a/an) + adjective + noun.
when_to_use.en: Use such + (a/an) + adjective + noun to emphasise a whole noun phrase.

when_to_use.vi: Khi một việc vượt quá mức cần thiết hoặc gây khó khăn, dùng too + adjective/adverb + to-infinitive.
when_to_use.en: Use too + adjective/adverb + to-infinitive when something is more than is wanted or possible.

when_to_use.vi: Khi một việc đạt đủ mức cần thiết, dùng adjective/adverb + enough + to-infinitive hoặc enough + noun.
when_to_use.en: Use adjective/adverb + enough + to-infinitive, or enough + noun, when something reaches the necessary level.

examples.text: It was so cold that the lake froze.

annotation.vi: so + tính từ nhấn mạnh mức độ, that dẫn đến kết quả.
annotation.en: so + adjective emphasises the degree, and that introduces the result.

translation.vi: Trời lạnh đến mức hồ đóng băng.
translation.en: It was so cold that the lake froze.

examples.text: It was such a difficult exam that many students failed.

annotation.vi: such + a + tính từ + danh từ nhấn mạnh cả cụm danh từ.
annotation.en: such + a + adjective + noun emphasises the whole noun phrase.

translation.vi: Đó là kỳ thi khó đến mức nhiều học sinh trượt.
translation.en: It was such a difficult exam that many students failed.

examples.text: The bag is too heavy to carry.

annotation.vi: too + tính từ + to-infinitive: vượt ngưỡng nên không thể mang.
annotation.en: too + adjective + to-infinitive: above the limit, so it cannot be carried.

translation.en: The bag is too heavy to carry.

common_mistakes.wrong: It was so a difficult problem.
common_mistakes.right: It was such a difficult problem.

reason.vi: so không đứng trước a + tính từ + danh từ; với cụm danh từ phải dùng such.
reason.en: so cannot come before a + adjective + noun; use such with a noun phrase.

quick_practice.q: It was ___ a difficult exam that many students failed.

explain.vi: Trước a + tính từ + danh từ dùng such, không dùng so.
explain.en: Use such before a + adjective + noun, not so.

quick_practice.q: He is ___ tall to reach the top shelf.

explain.vi: enough đứng sau tính từ: tall enough to reach.
explain.en: enough comes after the adjective: tall enough to reach.

quick_practice.q: The coffee is ___ hot to drink.

explain.vi: too + tính từ + to-infinitive diễn tả vượt ngưỡng, không uống được.
explain.en: too + adjective + to-infinitive means above the limit, so it cannot be drunk.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu dùng so + tính từ + that + kết quả về một trải nghiệm của bạn.
prompt.en: Write one sentence using so + adjective + that + result about an experience of yours.

sample.text: It was so cold that the lake froze.

corrections.issue: R5's formula only listed 'so + adjective/adverb; such + (a/an) + adjective + noun' and did not include the result clause with 'that', which is central to the examples.
corrections.fix: Added optional 'that' and 'result clause' slots to the formula so the pattern covers the full so/such result structure.

corrections.issue: R5's mistake 'He is enough tall to reach it' was correct in its diagnosis but the corrected sentence 'He is tall enough to reach it' was not included in the examples.
corrections.fix: Kept the correction and added a clean example 'The bag is too heavy to carry' to illustrate too + adjective + to-infinitive.

corrections.issue: R5's guided practice included a production prompt with 'Answers vary', which is not usable as a deterministic check.
corrections.fix: Replaced it with a personal_production card that has a concrete prompt, placeholder, sample, and a pattern_rule the app can check.
